topics.heading: Purpose and information
topics.rule: Design behavior before pages: identify applicable hover, focus, selected, disabled, loading, empty, success and error states.

topics.heading: Interaction and accessibility
topics.rule: Preserve accessible names, keyboard operation, visible focus and non-color cues. Keep required information available without hover or tooltips.

topics.heading: Forms and overlays
topics.rule: Give controls persistent labels, preserve typed values and explain invalid input. Prevent stale asynchronous results from replacing newer input.

topics.heading: Review
topics.rule: Reuse the project's tokens, recipes and primitives before adding new ones.

topics.heading: Inspiration sources
topics.rule: Research the interaction or information problem. Record useful patterns and synthesize them through the project's identity and existing components.
